title: Count adjacent runs without extra storage
prompt: A run is a consecutive group of equal values. Return the number of runs. The values 1,1,2,1 contain three runs. Empty input has zero. Use a single pass; tests check answers rather than allocation behavior.

tests.label: One run
tests.hint: Equal neighbors stay in the same run.

tests.label: Empty
tests.hint: Handle empty input before starting at one.

tests.label: Every item differs
tests.hint: Each changed neighbor starts a new run.

hints: A nonempty vector starts with one run.
Each later item starts a new run only when it differs from its predecessor.
explanation: Only the previous element matters. No auxiliary container is required, so this is a useful example of keeping a scan simple.
